_comment: LTX-2.3 distilled two-stage with the x1.5 rational spatial upscaler. target_height/target_width are the FINAL size; stage 1 runs at final/1.5. With a x1.5 ratio stage-1 pixels must be a multiple of 64 (vae stride 32 * denominator 2), so the reachable finals are multiples of 96 -- 960x1440 below maps exactly to a 640x960 stage 1. Ask for a non-reachable size and the runner snaps down and logs the size it actually produces. upsampler_spatial_scale is only needed to override the checkpoint metadata; normally the ratio is probed from the file.
